citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
During review of the semi-annual facility inspections and covered species protocols, the inspector reviewed inspection
records for fish and other non mammal aquatic species and asked for the animal and facility inspection records for the
covered mammals (not including free-living wild animals in their natural habitat). The research facility had not inspected
the covered animals and facilities associated with two covered mammal protocols that have been active since December
2024. The two semi-annual inspections conducted since that time did not include all the animal facilities and animal study
areas as required by the Animal Welfare Act. Research facilities and Institutional Animal Care and Use Committees must
inspect, at least once every six months, all of the research facilities animal facilities including animal study areas, using
title 9, chapter I, subchapter A- Animal Welfare as a basis for evaluation.
Correct by 23 July 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the Attending Veterinarian.

2024. The two semi-annual inspections conducted since that time did not include all the animal facilities and animal study 
areas as required by the Animal Welfare Act. Research facilities and Institutional Animal Care and Use Committees must 
inspect, at least once every six months, all of the research facilities animal facilities including animal study areas, using 
title 9, chapter I, subchapter A- Animal Welfare as a basis for evaluation. 
 
Correct by 23 July 2026 
 
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the Attending Veterinarian.
